lines.t: [Intro - Dark Upright Piano & Solitary Cello]
Left the porch light burning out in November rain
Counting up the cost of years spent running in vain
Sold my soul to promises that broke like glass
Hoping every shadow in the hall would pass
I was standing on the riverbank with heavy shoes
Carrying a weight I knew I couldn't choose
[Pre-Chorus]
When the bottom dropped beneath my feet, I called Your name
YahuShua's mercy stepped into the flame
[Chorus]
Do ya still remember grace that set me free?
YahuShua's endless love reaching down for me
Pulled me from the river when the current got dark
Ignited in my chest a holy spark
(Ooh-ooh, inside the dark)
[Verse 2]
Traced the scars across my hands to see the truth
Gave away the wreckage of a wasted youth
Every letter that I wrote to justify my pride
Fell away like autumn leaves I kept inside
Now the silence isn't cold, it’s a place to heal
Learning how to love the things that time can’t steal
[Chorus]
Do ya still remember grace that set me free?
YahuShua's endless love reaching down for me
Pulled me from the river when the current got dark
Ignited in my chest a holy spark
[Bridge]
I used to think the wilderness was dark
Until I looked up high into the midnight sky
YahuShua was there
The story doesn't end where the damage has been
[Solo - Solo Cello Counter-Melody with Dark Piano]
[Chorus]
Do ya still remember grace that set me free?
YahuShua's endless love reaching down for me
Pulled me from the river when the current got dark
Ignited in my chest a holy spark
[Outro]
Left the heavy shoes behind...
YahuShua shining through.
(Ooh-ooh)
Light in the dark.
[Fade Out]
[End]
